title: Use-After-Free in µD3TN BPv6 Fragmenter Cleanup allows Unauthenticated Remote Attacker to Cause DoS on Allocation…
description: A use-after-free vulnerability exists in the µD3TN BPv6 Fragmenter Cleanup component. This flaw allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause a denial of service (DoS) by triggering allocation failure during cleanup.
